tier_description: Single-Domain Reasoning — questions requiring multi-step inference within one domain (prerequisites, requirement progress, schedule feasibility, policy application, course equivalence)

category_descriptions.A: Prerequisite Satisfaction (10 questions) — determine if a student meets prereqs/coreqs for a course
category_descriptions.B: Requirement Progress (10 questions) — assess how many/which degree requirements a student has completed
category_descriptions.C: Schedule Feasibility (10 questions) — check for time conflicts or availability in a given semester
category_descriptions.D: Policy Application (10 questions) — apply a policy rule to a student's specific situation
category_descriptions.E: Course Equivalence (10 questions) — determine if a course substitution or equivalency is valid

schema.persona_id: Persona identifier (e.g. P-004) or null for generic questions
schema.question: Natural-language question requiring reasoning within one domain
schema.expected_answer: Correct answer derived from single-domain inference
schema.reasoning_type: Brief label for the reasoning pattern required
schema.common_mistake: Typical error an advising system might make on this question
schema.needs_verification: List of data sources needed to verify the answer

quality_notes: Each question requires multi-step inference but within exactly one domain
All 5 categories have exactly 10 questions each
36 of 50 questions are persona-grounded; 14 are generic
All course codes and persona IDs reference real data in the repository
needs_verification lists the specific data sources required for each question
common_mistake field documents a plausible but incorrect reasoning pattern
